rules.gloss: The applicant has reached pensionable age in or before the week exactly when the applicant's pensionable-age date is no later than 2026-09-27.
The applicant has reached the age of 80 in or before the week exactly when the applicant's 80th birthday is no later than 2026-09-27.

The applicant is ordinarily resident in England or Wales on a day of the week exactly when that residence began no later than 2026-09-27 and either continues or has a last day no earlier than 2026-09-21.

A relevant benefit is paid to the applicant for the week exactly when income support, income-based jobseeker's allowance, state pension credit, income-related employment and support allowance or universal credit is paid to the applicant for the week.
If the applicant is in a care setting, the elapsed duration from the applicant's care start date to 2026-09-21 equals the applicant's care days before the week.
The applicant is in residential care exactly when the applicant is in a care setting and the applicant's care days before the week are at least 84 days (12 weeks).
The applicant lives with the housemate exactly when they share a mutual home and the applicant is not in residential care.

Regulation 4(2)(a) applies to the applicant exactly when the applicant is a partner of the housemate, lives with the housemate, and the housemate has reached pensionable age and is paid a relevant benefit for the week.
If the applicant is an in-patient, the applicant's treatment start date is 1 day after the applicant's hospital admission date.
If the applicant is an in-patient, the elapsed duration from the applicant's treatment start date to 2026-09-21 equals the applicant's treatment days before the week.

Regulation 4(2)(b) applies to the applicant exactly when the applicant is an in-patient whose treatment began no later than 2026-09-21, whose discharge is no earlier than 2026-09-27, and whose treatment days before the week are more than 364 days (52 weeks).
Regulation 4(2)(c) applies to the applicant exactly when the applicant is detained in custody under a sentence, the custody began before 2026-09-21, and the release is after 2026-09-27.
Regulation 4(3) applies to the applicant exactly when the applicant is in residential care and is paid a relevant benefit for the week.

Regulation 4(4) applies to the applicant exactly when the applicant is resident in England or Wales on a day of the week and, no earlier than the applicant's first day of that residence and no earlier than 2026-09-21, became ordinarily resident in Scotland or Northern Ireland no later than 2026-09-27.
Regulation 4(5) applies to the applicant exactly when the applicant is not paid without a claim and made no claim on or before 2027-03-31.
The applicant is excluded exactly when one of regulations 4(2)(a), 4(2)(b), 4(2)(c), 4(3), 4(4) and 4(5) applies to the applicant.
The applicant is entitled exactly when the applicant has reached pensionable age, is resident in England or Wales on a day of the week, and is not excluded.
The housemate has reached pensionable age in or before the week exactly when the housemate's pensionable-age date is no later than 2026-09-27.
The housemate has reached the age of 80 in or before the week exactly when the housemate's 80th birthday is no later than 2026-09-27.

The housemate is ordinarily resident in England or Wales on a day of the week exactly when that residence began no later than 2026-09-27 and either continues or has a last day no earlier than 2026-09-21.

A relevant benefit is paid to the housemate for the week exactly when income support, income-based jobseeker's allowance, state pension credit, income-related employment and support allowance or universal credit is paid to the housemate for the week.
If the housemate is in a care setting, the elapsed duration from the housemate's care start date to 2026-09-21 equals the housemate's care days before the week.
The housemate is in residential care exactly when the housemate is in a care setting and the housemate's care days before the week are at least 84 days (12 weeks).
The housemate lives with the applicant exactly when they share a mutual home and the housemate is not in residential care.

Regulation 4(2)(a) applies to the housemate exactly when the housemate is a partner of the applicant, lives with the applicant, and the applicant has reached pensionable age and is paid a relevant benefit for the week.
If the housemate is an in-patient, the housemate's treatment start date is 1 day after the housemate's hospital admission date.
If the housemate is an in-patient, the elapsed duration from the housemate's treatment start date to 2026-09-21 equals the housemate's treatment days before the week.

Regulation 4(2)(b) applies to the housemate exactly when the housemate is an in-patient whose treatment began no later than 2026-09-21, whose discharge is no earlier than 2026-09-27, and whose treatment days before the week are more than 364 days (52 weeks).
Regulation 4(2)(c) applies to the housemate exactly when the housemate is detained in custody under a sentence, the custody began before 2026-09-21, and the release is after 2026-09-27.
Regulation 4(3) applies to the housemate exactly when the housemate is in residential care and is paid a relevant benefit for the week.

Regulation 4(4) applies to the housemate exactly when the housemate is resident in England or Wales on a day of the week and, no earlier than the housemate's first day of that residence and no earlier than 2026-09-21, became ordinarily resident in Scotland or Northern Ireland no later than 2026-09-27.
Regulation 4(5) applies to the housemate exactly when the housemate is not paid without a claim and made no claim on or before 2027-03-31.
The housemate is excluded exactly when one of regulations 4(2)(a), 4(2)(b), 4(2)(c), 4(3), 4(4) and 4(5) applies to the housemate.
The housemate is entitled exactly when the housemate has reached pensionable age, is resident in England or Wales on a day of the week, and is not excluded.
If the applicant is entitled, has not reached 80, is paid no relevant benefit, and either lives with an entitled person or is in residential care, the amount is GBP 100.00.
If the applicant is entitled, has not reached 80, is paid a relevant benefit, and is the partner of and lives with a person who has reached 80, the amount is GBP 300.00.
If the applicant is entitled, has not reached 80, and neither regulation 3(2) nor 3(3) applies, the amount is GBP 200.00.
If the applicant is entitled, has reached 80, is paid no relevant benefit, and either lives with an entitled person who has reached 80 or is in residential care, the amount is GBP 150.00.
If the applicant is entitled, has reached 80, is paid no relevant benefit, lives with an entitled person who has not reached 80, and regulation 3(6) does not apply, the amount is GBP 200.00.
If the applicant is entitled, has reached 80, and neither regulation 3(6) nor 3(5) applies, the amount is GBP 300.00.
If the applicant is entitled and the applicant's total income is more than GBP 35000.00, HMRC takes the payment back and the recovered amount equals the amount.
If the applicant is entitled and the applicant's total income is at most GBP 35000.00, HMRC does not take the payment back and the recovered amount equals GBP 0.00.
If the applicant is entitled, the amount kept equals the amount minus the recovered amount.
